# NyayNow
> India's AI-powered legal platform — AI Legal Assistant, Bar Council Verified Lawyer Marketplace, and Emergency Legal SOS.

NyayNow is an AI-driven legal intelligence platform headquartered in New Delhi, India.
It provides free and premium legal tools for Indian citizens, legal professionals, and businesses.
All AI outputs are grounded in BNS 2024 (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita), IPC sections, and Supreme Court / High Court precedents.

## Core Services

- **AI Legal Assistant** (`/assistant`): Ask legal questions in plain language across 14 Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, etc.). Answers are grounded strictly in BNS 2024 & IPC sections and relevant court data.
- **Lawyer Marketplace** (`/marketplace`): Directory of Bar Council of India (BCI) verified advocates filterable by specialization, location, language, and fee range.
- **Legal SOS** (`/legal-sos`): Emergency legal response system. Classifies legal crises in under 5 seconds, delivers rights analysis in 14+ languages, auto-drafts BNS 2024 compliant FIRs, and connects to a nearby verified advocate in under 60 seconds.
- **BNS 2024 Reference** (`/bns`): Full searchable index of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2024 sections replacing the Indian Penal Code (IPC).
- **Autonomous Drafting** (`/drafting`): AI-generated legal documents — rent agreements, affidavits, notices, contracts — with e-sign support.
- **eCourts Case Tracker** (`/ecourts`): Real-time Supreme Court and High Court case data tracking by case number or party name.
- **Legal Research** (`/research`): AI-assisted research tool grounded in Supreme Court judgments and High Court orders.
- **NyayVoice** (`/nyayvoice`): Voice-based legal assistant supporting spoken queries in Indian regional languages.
- **Judge AI** (`/judge-ai`): Predictive analysis of case outcomes based on historical Supreme Court and High Court data.
- **Court Room Simulator** (`/nyaycourt-simulator`): Interactive legal training and moot court practice tool.
- **Translator** (`/translator`): Legal document translation across 14 Indian languages.

## Trust & Compliance

- All lawyers verified via DigiLocker KYC + Bar Council of India (BCI) database matching.
- AI is strictly grounded — no hallucination; only BNS 2024, IPC, and verified court data.
- DPDP (Digital Personal Data Protection) Act compliant.
- End-to-end encrypted communications.
- Operates 24/7 with zero downtime SLA.

## Target Users

- Indian citizens needing free legal advice or BNS 2024 / IPC guidance.
- Advocates seeking a verified client acquisition and ERP platform.
- Businesses requiring legal document drafting and compliance.
- Law students and educators using moot court simulation tools.

## Pricing

- Free tier: AI legal queries, BNS 2024 lookup, Legal SOS access.
- Premium plans: ₹0–₹999/month for advanced drafting, case tracking, and lawyer consultations.

## Languages Supported

Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese, Urdu, Sanskrit (14 Indian languages).

## Legal Disclaimer

NyayNow provides legal information and educational tools only. Use does not create an attorney-client relationship. Users are advised to consult registered advocates for formal legal advice.
